_comment: Narrow data-limited exceptions for the UK replay qualification gate, reviewed like code under cos d1344. An entry requires the same attempt's budget_inputs result to confirm its required inputs are missing, and always requires a named reviewer's acceptance. The 17 October 2026 decision remains proposed pending independent review agreement; the review metadata records that status.

exceptions.cause: policyengine-uk#2241 charges SDLT higher rates on purchases, which uk-data does not yet impute.
exceptions.decided_under: cos d1344; Budget coordinator's data-limited exception proposal of 17 October 2026
exceptions.review: Proposed; the decision record requires independent review agreement before adoption and does not yet record that agreement.
